top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 physiology and incretin-therapy discovery is a mature, clearly field-changing achievement with decades of clinical validation in diabetes and obesity. The three-laureate allocation (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) is a defensible, rule-compliant division and the citation scope is precise, covering GLP-1 physiology and its active form. No award is clearly inferior to recognising this work.
